description: This file defines the Theme class within the Todaymade\Daux\Format\HTML namespace, extending BaseConfig and providing methods to retrieve theme-related configuration values such as fonts, CSS, JS, favicon, and templates.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A class extending BaseConfig that provides access to theme-specific configuration options.

methods.name: getFonts
methods.description: Returns the font configuration for the theme.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Returns the CSS configuration for the theme.

methods.name: getJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript configuration for the theme.

methods.name: getFavicon
methods.description: Returns the favicon configuration for the theme.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Returns the templates configuration for the theme.
